changeSet.author: devops
changeSet.comment: Table for player personal notes, one row per campaign
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE campaign_notes ( campaign_id BIGINT NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', updated TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), CONSTRAINT pk_campaign_notes PRIMARY KEY (campaign_id), CONSTRAINT fk_campaign_notes_campaign FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id) REFERENCES campaign (character_id) ON DELETE CASCADE );
